rules.numbers: every number, date or amount in a post must be one of the item's allowed_numbers or context_numbers, as written there (- and − alike); never the same number twice in a post
rules.picks: never name or hint at the #1 pick; it is locked and not in this file
rules.no_advice: no buy / sell calls, predictions or price targets; every post carries the disclaimer
rules.descriptive: chart_pattern and moves_like describe what happened only (no forecasts; their items' banned_words apply too); moves_like may cashtag only the peers listed in its item
rules.cashtags: at most 4 distinct cashtags, all from the item's tickers + context_tickers; a single-ticker item names its own $TICKER; moves_like may add its peers, picks_ready the public picks
rules.order: items are sorted by audience_rank (rank / rank_why: recognisability, magnitude, freshness, novelty); the first 8 (top8 true) are a varied menu: at most 2 session-map items (P1 P2 P6 P7), at most one small cap, no lead ticker or headline number repeated between them, 4+ pillars when the day has them; items below carry top8_out (why). Pick across pillars per variety
rules.claims: comparatives and superlatives (led, biggest, largest, worst, best, most, least, only, first, top, #1, record, 'outperformed every other') only as the item's claims state them: name only that claim's companies / sectors in that sentence; each claim has a polarity (best = top gainer, worst = top loser, null = no side) and a rank (1 = its one subject is #1; group = its subjects are the top N in order) and a metric (usd_change, pct_change, market_cap, ...): say the side with the noun ('top loser', 'led the drop', 'biggest gainer'; 'top' / 'led' / '#1' alone read as best, whatever number stands beside them), say the metric as the claim does (dollars vs percent vs market cap), the singular ('the biggest drop') only for the rank-1 subject, a list only from #1 in order, 'among the biggest' for other members, 'the two biggest' only for exactly the top 2; 'of the 500' / 'overall' only with a claim that has no within, 'of the 10' for the basket; a sector only as a sector claim (kind sector) says, a stock 'within' a sector only with that sector or 'its sector' named; never widen the window ('ever', 'in months', 'of the quarter', 'since September', a week on a one-session item) or call the session 'today' / 'yesterday' unless the item's when does; no negated comparisons; never say a stock led its sector unless sector_leaders / claims say so; never put a company in a sector its ticker_sectors entry does not show

pillars.P0: picks + scoreboard (max 1 a day per platform)
pillars.P3: smart money in names you know (congress_flow, insider_flow, form4_buy, congress_trade, ptr_summary)
pillars.P7: breadth and the typical stock (breadth_day, basket_week)

variety: no same pillar twice in a row among a platform's own posts
at most 2 posts per pillar per platform per day
the same primary ticker on one platform not within 3 trading days (earnings results exempt)
a first line sharing >= 60% of its first 8 words with one of the platform's last 10 own posts is rejected
the same item on 2+ platforms: a different first line and >= 30% different wording
market-level pillars (P1 P2 P3 flows P4 P6 P7) >= 50% of own posts per platform per week; single filings <= 25%; picks <= 1 a day; <= 1 small-cap post in 4 (defaults; Growth tunes them)
the item's angles are first-line seeds, not templates: rotate the angle per pillar
rules.wording: every post of every item type: our universe is 'the 500 largest US-listed stocks' (or 'the 500 largest US-listed companies'), never 'S&P 500', 'S&P', 'SPX' or 'the index' (only a picks post may compare with the benchmark, as 'vs SPY'); 'the 10 largest US-listed companies', not 'US companies'; a 5-session window is worded as the item's when field says ('in the week to Oct 16', 'last week'); the 30-day insider totals are 'open-market buys / sells by officers and directors over 30 days in our feed'; a post never contradicts its card (card_message); market items: no 'crash', 'bloodbath', 'dump'
rules.cards: a market item's media is its pinned share card (card.url, a file on our Pages site, the same numbers the item states); never the live /market/card/ URL, never another day's card; no link in the main post: the UTM link goes in a self-reply
